Design scope

What the architecture covers

Design the building around work, movement and long-term flexibility. We coordinate floor plates, cores, parking, services and facade before tenants move in.

01Efficient floor platesBalance usable workspace, circulation, daylight and structural spans.
02Cores and vertical movementPosition stairs, lifts, washrooms and risers for safe, clear access.
03Lobby and arrivalCreate a legible entrance for staff, visitors and tenant identity.
04Parking and service accessPlan vehicles, drop-off, loading and back-of-house movement.
05Facade and performanceCoordinate appearance, openings, shade and maintainable materials.
06Construction informationDevelop plans, sections, elevations and details for coordination.

Eight-step process

From brief to buildable drawings

Each stage closes the important decisions before the next one begins.

01

Brief and site analysis

Confirm the project brief, review the site and record the constraints that shape the design.

02

Concept planning

Test layout, zoning, access and movement before the architectural form is fixed.

03

Form and 3D studies

Develop the exterior character and review key views, proportions and materials.

04

Design development

Resolve dimensions, openings, levels, materials and the key technical decisions.

05

Working drawings

Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations and the agreed construction details.

06

Authority submission

Develop the required architectural set around the relevant approval process.

07

Structural and MEP coordination

Align grids, shafts, plant, fire routes and building services with the floor plates.

08

Final handover

Issue the agreed drawing package for pricing, coordination and construction.

Architecture fees

A clear range before the proposal

The fee covers architectural design and drawings. Construction, interior design and fit-out are separate unless they are added to the brief.

IncludedConcept design, floor plates, facade studies, working drawings and consultant coordination.
Final feeThe final proposal reflects building area, floors, parking strategy, approvals and consultant requirements.
Separate costsGovernment charges, surveys and third-party specialist fees are confirmed separately where needed.
Indicative design feePKR 1M–3M

The final proposal reflects building area, floors, parking strategy, approvals and consultant requirements.

Request a proposal

After architecture

Carry the idea into the interior

Tenant interiors can be developed through Woodex Interior Design, with office fit-out handled as a separate delivery scope.
